title: alchemilla hoppeana subsp. grossidens
intro: Alchemilla hoppeana subsp. grossidens, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae, is a type of alpine meadow plant native to certain regions of Europe and Asia. The plant is used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated skin. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla hoppeana subsp. grossidens include astringent and anti-edematous effects, making it useful for treating wounds, burns, and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
